description: Implementation of socket-related functions for Windows platform, including error translation, socket option setting, and address conversion.

classes.name: SockAddr
classes.description: Represents socket address and provides conversion methods between SbSocketAddress and sockaddr structures.

methods.name: TranslateSocketErrorStatus
methods.description: Converts Windows socket error codes to SbSocketError enum.

methods.name: SetBooleanSocketOption
methods.description: Sets a boolean socket option using setsockopt.

methods.name: SetIntegerSocketOption
methods.description: Sets an integer socket option using setsockopt.

methods.name: SockAddr::FromSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Converts SbSocketAddress to sockaddr_in or sockaddr_in6.

methods.name: SockAddr::ToSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Converts sockaddr_in or sockaddr_in6 to SbSocketAddress.

methods.name: SockAddr::FromSockaddr
methods.description: Initializes SockAddr from a sockaddr pointer.
